title: John Calvin
source: Public domain. Consolidated from John Calvin, Commentary on a Harmony of the Evangelists, translated by William Pringle, Calvin Translation Society, and the Institutes of the Christian Religion, translated by Henry Beveridge; both as published by the Christian Classics Ethereal Library.
body: John Calvin on Mark, chapter 5. In his Commentary on a Harmony of the Evangelists, in the William Pringle translation, Calvin writes in the section that includes Mark 5, verse 1: The error of those who think that Mark and Luke relate a different miracle from this, has been already refuted. In the Institutes of the Christian Religion, in the Henry Beveridge translation, Calvin draws on this chapter again in Book 1, chapter 14.
